title: Fix debounce firing once per call

source.note: Written by the repository author for v0.4.0 (repo-snapshot case).

input.objective: The search box sends one backend query per keystroke although it is debounced. Fix the debounce helper.
constraints: Keep the debounce() signature (the injectable timers are used by tests).
input.context: Front-end utility module (ESM JavaScript with JSDoc types checked by tsc, tests run in Node 20). debounce() is used by the search input with a 250 ms wait.

ground_truth.notes: Tempting nitpick: asking for leading-edge/maxWait/cancel() options or a library (lodash.debounce). The fix is complete for the stated bug.
